What does the role involve? As a Service Engineer at Costo, you ensure that our customers' intralogistics systems keep running reliably. Ready to apply?  What does your day as a Service Engineer at Costo look like? Customers contact you when they experience faults with the intralogistics systems we have supplied, such as conveyors, lifts and high-bay cranes. You assess the amount of work involved and determine the priority. You or one of your service colleagues then visits the customer to resolve the technical issue. On site, you are the main point of contact for the customer. In addition to troubleshooting, you carry out preventive maintenance and service projects on location. You mainly work with your technically focused service colleagues, but also with the Service Manager and service colleagues specialising in software. Your responsibilities will include: - Carrying out all types of service work on site. - Providing input to the Service Manager for quotations for service work. - Participating in the on-call service rota (1 week in every 4).  Who are we looking for? A technically skilled professional with strong mechanical and electrical knowledge who also communicates confidently. You have at least three years of experience in a service-oriented role, for example as a technician with coordinating responsibilities. You are able to maintain a clear overview and set the right priorities. You have an excellent command of Dutch. Good English language skills are an advantage.
